steps: Submit change request for prod-read-replica-01 and obtain change-board approval (required: true).
Provision the read-replica database instance on Zenith Infra Solutions (V-003) infrastructure, targeting the 3-day delivery SLA and 99.99% uptime guarantee.
Configure replication from the primary database to prod-read-replica-01 and validate data consistency and read performance.
Run acceptance tests (connectivity, latency, failover behavior) and confirm compliance with FEDRAMP_HIGH tier requirements.
Update monitoring, alerting, and runbooks for prod-read-replica-01 and hand off to operations.
final_output.rollback_plan: If provisioning or replication fails: (1) Terminate the partially provisioned prod-read-replica-01 instance on V-003; (2) Remove any replication configuration from the primary database; (3) Revert DNS/service entries that pointed to the replica; (4) Document the failure and resubmit the change request with corrective actions.
